title: Developer orientation cardset for API & SDK startup screenshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, reusable set of orientation 'card' assets and annotated screenshots for the API/SDK quickstart pages and docs. Deliver a focused bundle that demonstrates: (1) authentication flows (API key creation, rotating ephemeral keys), (2) streaming responses (progressive tokens, cancelation affordances), and (3) tool-calling examples (function signatures, structured outputs). Assets should be sized for docs hero, inline guides, and social preview thumbnails, include light and dark variants, and have motion guidance for short GIF exports.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero screenshot compositions (1200x600) demonstrating auth, streaming, tool-calls with annotated microcopy
Six inline screenshot sizes (800x450 and 600x300) optimized for docs pages with accessible contrast
Three thumbnail variations (320x180) for quickstart cards and social previews
SVG iconset (auth, key, streaming, function) with exported 1x/2x/3x PNGs
Two short GIFs (max 8s, <2MB each) showing streaming tokens and a tool-call lifecycle
Design tokens and copy snippets exported to Figma component library with usage notes
Handoff package uploaded to Drive with filenames matching mockup_filenames field and a linked Confluence page
tasks: Audit existing quickstart screenshots and collate reusable elements (icons, snippet styles)
Design card layout templates: hero, inline, thumbnail; include dark/light themes
Compose auth flow screenshot: key creation modal, key rotation microcopy, success state
Compose streaming screenshot + GIF: streaming delta overlay, cancel button, latency indicator
Compose tool-call screenshot: function signature panel, JSON result preview, error fallback state
Create SVG iconset and export PNG variants
Write microcopy text for each annotation and get PM approval
Prototype in Figma and share review link with PM/Docs/Engineering
Iterate on feedback, finalize assets, and export handoff bundle to Drive + Confluence
assets_spec: Hero: 1200x600 PNG, dark + light, annotated layers preserved in Figma
Inline: 800x450 and 600x300 PNGs, accessible color variations
Thumbnail: 320x180 PNG, optimized legibility at small sizes
GIFs: 720x360, 8s max, under 2MB, looping preview and non-looping demo version

Source: Figma file with components, pages for each mockup, and a README frame for dev handoff
